titulo: One look in the oven before preheating
caption:
One look in the oven before preheating

She was about to preheat. One look inside found last night's tray still sitting there.

Looking takes two seconds, and it beats finding something in there at the wrong moment.

For whoever looks inside before turning it on.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a tall oven on the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the oven door drops open. A flat tray is sitting inside and a bubble says forgot the tray. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me, the oven's obviously empty, to: looked first. the tray was in.
